data.long_meaning: Avneesh is a Sanskrit name, derived from the root words 'avan' meaning desire and 'ish' meaning lord. It signifies one who longs for or is devoted to a particular deity or goal. The name Avneesh carries the meaning “Desire, Longing” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Avneesh usually hope their child will grow to embody desire, longing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
